It sounds incredibly stressful to want to help your daughter but feel limited by financial constraints. As a parent, it is completely natural to want to provide the care she needs, and it can be heartbreaking when the costs are out of reach. Please remember that you are doing your best with the resources you have, and this financial barrier is not a failure on your part. 

Since she went for two weeks last year, she has already shown a willingness to seek support, which is a very positive sign. You might encourage her to look into community health centers, which often offer services on a sliding scale based on income, or explore free support groups that can provide coping strategies and a sense of community. Simply being there to offer your emotional support and a listening ear makes a significant difference while you both navigate these hurdles.
